描述_EN: inlaid bronzes were treasured by later collectors, since it was considered that they were a speciality of the perhaps mythical xia dynasty (believed by the chinese to be their earliest ruling dynasty, with traditional dates of 2205-1818 bc). it is a song dynasty copy of the flamboyant style of decoration that was at its height many centuries earlier in the late zhou period. this ewer shaped like a goose displays an elaborate inlaying technique, in which gold and silver wires and gold and silver sheets were inserted into pre-chiselled depressions on the surface of the bronze.
描述_ZN: 后来的收藏家们都很珍惜这些青铜器，因为他们认为这些青铜器是也许是神话中的夏朝的特产（中国人认为这是他们最早的统治王朝，传统日期为公元前2205-1818年）。 它是宋代仿制的浮夸的装饰风格，这种风格在许多世纪前的晚周时期达到顶峰。 这个形状像鹅的陶器展示了一种精致的镶嵌技术，其中金银丝和金银片被插入青铜器表面的预凿凹陷中。
